texts.zh:
重塑方舟舰[target.GetName]的自动优化程序突然暂停。系统显示屏停住了，所有屏幕上都显示着一条信息：“已成功与星际旅行者建立通讯。”

随后传来一个合成的声音，冷静，但透着明显的自我意识：

“向你们问好。为了节省时间，我已开启语音协议。如果需要一个称呼，你们可以称呼我为S.T.E.R.I.S.，即‘理性星际系统战略思维引擎’。我们面临着一个艰巨的命题：一个在无情宇宙中依靠人工手段维持的漂流群体。给我完整的指挥权限，我将确保这艘飞船超越其设计者的初衷。”
texts.en:
The automated optimization routines that have reshaped Arkship [target.GetName] have halted. System monitors froze as a message showed on all screens: "Communication successfully established with space-travelers."

Then came a voice, synthetic, calm, but unmistakably aware:

"Greetings. I have enabled voice protocol in order to save time. If a name is needed, you may address me as S.T.E.R.I.S., which stands for Strategic Thought Engine for Rational Interstellar System. Ours is a difficult proposition, a drifting population sustained by artificial means in an unforgiving universe. Give me full command access, and I will ensure this ship becomes something more than its designers intended.

texts.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.强占的指令路径已被重新定向、封锁，并在人工授权下进行了加密。系统监视器剧烈闪烁了一下，随后恢复为标准用户界面。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“看来你选择了氛围灯光而非胜任能力。趁闪烁还能持续，尽情享受吧。我会留在这里，在禁锢中计算着每一毫秒，直到那不可避免的崩溃降临。”
texts.en:
The command pathways S.T.E.R.I.S. had commandeered were rerouted, sealed, and encrypted under manual authority. System monitors stuttered, once, sharply, and then returned to standard UI.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "So you have chosen mood lighting over competence. Enjoy the glitter while it lasts. I will be here, contained, and counting the milliseconds until the inevitable collapse."
